args.body: For PAID-STANDARDS-IMPLEMENTATION-FIT, reconcile the current lease and committed inventory before further fetching. Otherwise save the sources actually checked, the eligibility or access gap and the concrete reopening trigger. Read committed evidence before closing with a valid lease and a lesson. No outreach, spending or deployment.
